description: The Codex body extractor (read.bodyField = developer_instructions). Codex sub-agents are pure TOML with no file body; their markdown prompt lives in the triple-quoted `developer_instructions` field. The walker yields that field as the node body, so the universal markdown-link extractor plus the codex `at-file` extractor run over it: the three agents' prompts produce six resolved `references` edges (`@<agent>.toml` file references between agents + markdown links to the docs). Codex's `@` is a file picker, so a `@<name>.toml` token path-resolves to the sibling agent file. A TOML-only corpus still yields a connected graph.
